Insight Employment are recruiting a Contracts Manager for one client’s who supply critical care products to the healthcare sector.

It is not necessarily office based, but being withing driving distance to either Letchworth or Barnsley would be beneficial for the occasions an office visit may be needed.

JOB SUMMARY / OVERALL PURPOSE OF ROLE: –

This newly created role will support the Sales Director by taking ownership of the preparation, submission of customer tenders and framework agreements. The role will oversee all elements of submission, including Carbon Reduction Plan development, Modern Slavery assessments and working closely with Compliance on regulatory matters.

KEY RESPONSIBILITES: –

  • Lead the preparation, submission and ongoing maintenance of tenders and framework agreements with NHS Supply Chain, including full lifecycle management from opportunity identification through to award and post-award administration.
  • Manage all interactions with the Find a Tender service and the Jaggaer One (NHS Supply Chain eProcurement) portal, ensuring accurate, timely and compliant submissions.
  • Coordinate responses to Scottish Procurement opportunities and other relevant public-sector frameworks.
  • Work closely with the regulatory team to ensure full compliance with medical device regulatory requirements, including CE marking, MDD/MDR transition, ISO standards, UK Responsible Person (UKRP) obligations and MHRA registration/maintenance.
  • Oversee Carbon Reduction Plan development and reporting, Evergreen Sustainable Supplier Assessment submissions and ongoing maturity progression.
  • Manage Modern Slavery statements, risk assessments and ongoing compliance obligations in line with NHS and UK legislation and experience with the Cabinet office website for assessment completion.
  • Maintain accurate contract records, monitor performance KPIs, manage variations, extensions and renewals, and ensure all contractual obligations are met.
  • Collaborate closely with management team to gather evidence, collate responses and deliver high-quality submissions.
  • Provide clear commercial and compliance advice to the wider business on framework rules and supplier obligations.
  • Identify and mitigate contractual, regulatory and reputational risks associated with public-sector healthcare contracting.
  • Be ahead of the curve with upcoming frameworks working closely with the Sales Director to explore potential opportunities for growth.

 

In addition to the duties and responsibilities listed, the jobholder is required to carry out such other duties as may be required and as may be assigned by the Company from time to time.

KEY REQUIREMENTS: –

  • Proven track record of managing NHS Supply Chain framework submissions and ongoing contract maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience of the Find a Tender portal and Jaggaer One (or equivalent NHS Supply Chain eProcurement systems).
  • Strong working knowledge of Carbon Reduction reporting, Evergreen Assessment and Modern Slavery requirements within NHS procurement.
  • Solid understanding of medical device regulatory frameworks: CE marking, MDD/MDR, relevant ISO standards, UKRP responsibilities and MHRA processes.
  • Experience of Scottish & Northern Ireland Procurement frameworks and processes.
  • Demonstrable experience of working within regulated healthcare or medical device supply environments.
  • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple complex tenders and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, accurate tender responses.
  • Analytical and commercially aware, with the confidence to interpret complex contractual and regulatory requirements.
  • Proactive and solutions-focused approach to problem-solving and risk management.
  • Excellent management skills – able to work collaboratively across internal teams and with external NHS bodies.
  • Resilient under pressure and comfortable working to tight timescales.
  • High level of integrity and commitment to ethical, compliant and sustainable business practices.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while remaining a strong team player.
  • Relevant degree or professional qualification in business, law, procurement, regulatory affairs or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
  • Membership of a relevant professional body (e.g. CIPS) is desirable.

Salary: –

47.5K to 55k per annum depending on location and experience

Insight Employment are seeking Quality Assurance Technician to work for a client of ours in Buckingham.

The Role: –

Assist in the compliance of product safety, quality legality and authenticity in the production of the client’s products at the Buckingham site. Ensuring compliance with site, UK, and Group policies. This role will focus on working with production to ensure Quality Procedures, CCP’s and Good Manufacturing Practices are adhered to. Supporting the wider UK Technical team is an essential part of this role – engagement with other functions will be required as necessary – these include and are not limited to R&D, Operations, Commercial, Finance.

The task list below is by no means exhaustive and additional duties can often arise, dependant on specific business requirements and priorities may have to change at little or no notice to satisfy customer and business needs.

Key Tasks: –

  • Assist with the testing of finished products on the factory floor and at dispatch
  • Ensure all CCP checks are completed and recorded accordingly
  • Accurate recording of analytical results
  • Report and communicate incidences of non-conformance and maintain the Failure Log
  • Assist in the investigation of non-conformances using root cause analysis
  • Reporting supplier non-conformances
  • Daily equipment calibration tests
  • GMP, hygiene auditing of the site
  • Hygiene swabbing as per schedule
  • Glass and plastic audits as per schedule
  • Document control and upkeep of incoming goods COA, COC and delivery notes
  • Micro sample recording and data trending
  • General QA duties including but not limited to, production packing checks, label checking and reconciliation, blast, and chiller temperature checks
  • Upkeep and maintenance of the SAP system for customer COA retrieval, batch data input, finished product and raw material release, blocking non-conforming stock from release
  • Audit support – customer and third-party audits
  • Support and assist customers and internal departments such as production, customer services and R&D
  • Assist in any technical matters as directed

Requirements: –

  • HACCP and Food Safety Level 3
  • Experience (years & type of experience):

3+ years of Quality management in the food industry

Supervision/Management of teams

  • Languages: English required
  • ICT: Proficient in Microsoft Suite tools including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and in SAP transactions
  • Other expertise:

Strong written & verbal communication skills

Strong mathematics skills

Ability to work collaboratively with the site teams

Strong analytic and problem-solving skills

Strong organizational, planning and influencing skills

Skills: –

  • Collaborating Effectively: Thinking and acting as one team in a spirit of trust and respect. Being open to different ideas. Working intentionally towards consensus in the achievement of shared objectives. Building formal and informal relationship networks
  • Communicating Effectively: Developing and delivering communications in diverse modes that generate a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Driving Performance: Showing ambition and going the extra mile in achieving expected results; Driving sustainable operational excellence through diligent planning, prioritization, monitoring & effective use of resources; Taking responsibility for decisions, actions, and mistakes. Dealing with setbacks and unexpected situations in a positive and confident way
  • Improving continuously: Being enthusiastic about achieving high quality standards for oneself and the organization. Constantly looking for and taking advantage of improvement opportunities. Proposing innovative ideas and demonstrating openness for change. Building self-awareness and embracing learning and development opportunities
  • Managing Customer Needs: Being able and eager to find out what the internal or external customer wants and needs and to act accordingly, taking the organization’s costs and benefits into account. Making the life of the customer easier. Fostering a customer centric culture
  • Developing and Leading Others
